title: Airspeed: requirements with a real variable
shows: Real variables checked with the SMT engine of nuXmv: a set of requirements that cannot hold together because the airspeed changes slowly, the requirements in conflict, and the fixed set with a behavior. A reduced form of the Lift-Plus-Cruise case study of FRET (demos repository, LiftPlusCruise).
requirements: R1. The airspeed kias is 120 at the start.
R2. The airspeed changes by 10 at most at each step.
R3. The vehicle hovers only when kias is 30 or less.
R4. The airspeed is never negative.
R5. The vehicle hovers within 6 steps (R5b: within 10 steps).

steps.note: kias' is the value at the next step, so R2 compares kias at two steps: the exact regions do not apply and nuXmv checks it with its SMT engine (reals is smt). From 120, kias needs 9 steps to reach 30, so the vehicle cannot hover within 6 steps. The core is R1, R2, R3 and R5: R4 plays no part. Report the requirements by their number.
Within 10 steps it can: the witness trace has real values, kias going down by 10 at each step until the vehicle hovers.
